# This drives the production fixed-tick command/update loop.
start
press forward
frames 120
release forward
expect z -13 0.0001
expect ticks 120 0
pause
press forward
frames 600
expect z -13 0.0001
expect ticks 120 0
expect held 0 0
start
frames 60
expect z -13 0.0001
press forward
press backward
frames 60
expect z -13 0.0001
release backward
frames 600
release forward
expect z -22.45 0.15
expect ticks 840 0
